hints.text: 'Oddly' and 'cancelled' are our indicators — one is a selector (telling us which letters to select) and the other is a deletion indicator (we'll need to delete something).
Our fodder is 'exhibit' — we'll need to use these letters as directed by the indicator(s).

Applying the indicators to the fodder won't quite get us to the answer! This is unusual! Once we've done that, we'll need to apply one more technique - a common substitute - to get to our answer. That's why the question mark is here, flagging a bit of extra stretch.
The definition is 'Midday' — our answer will be a word meaning this time of day.
